scope: Push and pull-request CI audit and repairs; branch protection intentionally unchanged at the user request.

findings.finding: Screenshot collection ran automatically on pushes without assertions.
findings.resolution: Windows screenshots now has only workflow_dispatch.

findings.finding: Lint failure prevented runtime checks in a single sequential job.
findings.resolution: Grammar, lint, typecheck, fuzz smoke, unit/mock and browser suites run independently; CI result aggregates failures and cancellations while accepting intentional skips.

findings.finding: Only one of two generated grammars was checked.
findings.resolution: The generated-file guard checks both Lezer grammar directories.

findings.finding: Unrelated marketing edits triggered native and image jobs while no automatic landing build existed.
findings.resolution: Git-based change classification scopes expensive checks and adds landing and iPad frontend builds; missing history, manual runs and unknown build inputs run everything.

findings.finding: Current lint gate had 23 test warnings and two production warnings in the new landing copy control.
findings.resolution: Removed redundant assertions, avoided the RegExp.test conditional-test false positive, and retained clipboard fallback with explicit optional runtime typing.

findings.finding: Native image test searched visible text Replace Image… although the button displays Replace… with aria-label Replace Image….
findings.resolution: Use the accessible label for selection, click and retention assertions.

findings.finding: Image oracle tried a literal MuPDF SVG filename that differs across versions.
findings.resolution: Use an explicit page-number pattern and rename the first page to the canonical artifact; remove stale page output first. Old/current filename behavior and missing-fresh-output rejection are regression tested.

findings.finding: A background macOS WebView left all dock panels empty after switching from a Beamer example to a TikZ file.
findings.resolution: Explicitly redraw FlexLayout after installing a new model so measured tabs render without waiting for the background ResizeObserver. Retain the mounted Layout to avoid its existing visibility-listener retention issue. Correct two over-escaped mock TikZ fixtures and improve failure-state/timeout diagnostics.

findings.finding: After the selector and layout fixes, native image editing passed through reload but failed its final picker assertion.
findings.resolution: Match the existing graphics-import picker contract used by deck-graphics-replacement.ts; retain the assertion and all real native I/O and PDF.js checks.

workflows.actionlint: v1.7.12; all workflow files passed; shellcheck unavailable and disabled
workflows.resultAggregation: Success, intentional skips, and 28 failure/cancellation combinations passed against the actual workflow script.

articleImages.reference: MuPDF SVG / librsvg; Poppler control diagnostic

builds: iPad frontend typecheck and production build

webBrowser.note: Full suite before the additional background-layout redraw; focused final browser checks are recorded separately.

nativeMacOS.nativeImageOperations: Real native open/read/write, image import, PDF.js, undo/redo, save/reload; only picker choices are deterministic.

validation.lintCi: passed (production, tests and knip); final modified desktop scripts also linted
validation.grammar: Both generators rerun; no differences in either grammar directory.

finalBrowser.scope: Final production rebuild: Beamer workspace, source placeholders and real PDF image editing/history/reload.

oracleChanges.rasterizer: unchanged; only output filename handling fixed

limits: Fresh Windows and Linux native execution requires GitHub runners; neither was run on this macOS host. No post-change GitHub run exists before pushing.
MuPDF 1.23 filename behavior was simulated in regression tests; live image comparisons ran with local MuPDF 1.28.6.
No native iOS build or device test; the added iPad job checks the frontend only.
No large image fuzz soak or independent TeX run of the recursive image grammar. Other saved campaigns, including design/beamer-failure-ledger.json, are not revalidated by these bounded samples.
Deterministic PR fuzz checks native invariants and metamorphic behavior without a TeX oracle; independent image fidelity results are recorded separately.

diagnosticHistory.finding: Opened source was present in the store, but all dock panels were absent. The old timeout message captured empty values before polling.
Correcting the invalid mock source did not fix the missing panels; the layout issue is independent.
Layout fix cleared the earlier failure. Final image assertion used the obsolete picker kind graphics rather than graphics-import.
Image oracle ENOENT occurred before comparisons. That tooling-error run is not a successful fidelity comparison.

knownUnverifiedSupportGaps: Generic brace groups with a bare font declaration and block-level children still hit the frontend restriction. Not yet independently reduced.
Non-default heading struts and class-specific named sizes in overlay-picture node text need further independent checks.
Rounded-block width comparisons do not directly trace rounded background edges; centered text caught the pre-shrink width bug but simple prose alone could miss it.

knownOracleLimitations.status: Original 1600px paint-mask mismatch retained; the fixture explicitly uses 3200px and passes the same strict zero-interior-disagreement contract.
knownOracleLimitations.reason: One pixel in a letter counter changes mask membership at 1600px. This raster-resolution limitation is separate from the 61 original complex frames accepted above.
